'''Fang Fuquan''' ({{lang-zh|s=方复全|t=方復全|p=Fāng Fùquán}}; born October 1964) is a Chinese mathematician. He is one of the leading mathematicians in the fields of [[geometry]] and [[topology]] in China.<ref>{{cite news |title=Fang Fuquan |url=http://eng.cnu.edu.cn/academics/renowned/changjiang/57308.htm |access-date=8 October 2018 |work=cnu.edu.cn |date=26 June 2015 |archive-date=8 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181008095904/http://eng.cnu.edu.cn/academics/renowned/changjiang/57308.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> He is a delegate to the [[13th National People's Congress]].

==Biography==
Fang was born in [[Tongcheng, Anhui|Tongcheng]], [[Anhui]] in October 1964. His father was a small official in his hometown during the [[Republic of China (1912-1949)]]. Because of his record, he was denounced as a "counterrevolutionary" and suffered [[political persecution]] during the [[Cultural Revolution]]. He entered [[Huazhong University of Science and Technology]] in September 1983, majoring in [[applied mathematics]] at the Department of Mathematics, where he graduated in 1986.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://news.hust.edu.cn/2017/1128/c155a88895/page.htm |script-title=zh:四校友分别当选两院院士 |work=hust.edu.cn |date=2017-11-28 |language=zh |access-date=2018-10-08 |archive-date=2018-10-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181008095950/http://news.hust.edu.cn/2017/1128/c155a88895/page.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> After a short period of teaching at his alma mater, he earned his doctor's degree from [[Jilin University]] in 1991. Fang pursued advanced studies in [[Germany]], he did post-doctoral research at [[Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz]] from 1993 to 1994.

He returned to China in May 1994 and that year became associate professor at [[Nankai University]]. He was a visiting scholar of [[Max Planck Society]] from October 1995 to June 1996 and then [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques]] from July 1996 to June 1997.

He joined the faculty of [[Capital Normal University]] in November 2004 and was promoted to dean of the Department of Mathematics in July 2015. In July 2016 he was appointed vice-president of Capital Normal University, a position at vice-ministerial level.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.cnu.edu.cn/xxgk/xrld/fxz/88680.htm |script-title=zh:首都师范大学副校长方复全 |work=Capital Normal University |date=2017 |language=zh |access-date=2018-10-08 |archive-date=2018-10-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181008134918/http://www.cnu.edu.cn/xxgk/xrld/fxz/88680.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He was elected as a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] on November 28, 2017.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |script-title=zh:关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告 |work=cas.cn |date=2017-11-28 |language=zh |access-date=2018-10-08 |archive-date=2018-08-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180801191730/http://www.casad.cas.cn/doc/17503.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
